subject: Aurora Analytics private offer: drawdown pacing & GCP co-sell handoff
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@auroraanalytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Private offer & initial drawdown plan

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Aurora is excited to get a private offer established in GCP Marketplace. Procurement asked for a suggested drawdown pacing so they can align internal PO and budget windows.

High-level ask: can Redwood propose a month-by-month redemption cadence for a 12-month committed private offer (we're targeting $1.2M committed usage across GCP SKUs)? We'd like a conservative front-load/steady plan that keeps us eligible for co-sell and maps to our Q3/Q4 pilots.

Also: who on your side will own the co-sell listing and marketplace handoff? We need a short checklist to show to our cloud partner rep.

Attaching: aurora-deal-summary.pdf (deal one-pager)

Thanks —
Sam Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Aurora Analytics

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@auroraanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Private offer & initial drawdown plan

Sam —

Appreciate the one-pager. We're happy to run this as a GCP private offer and coordinate the co-sell handoff. Draft thoughts below (high level) — happy to iterate: 

- Suggested 12-month drawdown split (monthly % of committed spend): 25% / 35% / 15% / 10% / 5% / remaining distributed evenly across months 6-12 (conservative front-load to support pilot bursts).
- Rationale: front-load supports pilot cluster usage while later months protect against over-commit.
- Items we need from Aurora: exact SKU list for the Marketplace listing, billing entity name on PO, and your procurement contact (for DocuSign/PO routing).
- Co-sell ownership: Marissa will be our co-sell lead for listing + GCP engagement; Jonas will own ops on onboarding and SKU wiring; Ben will support invoicing cadence.

I've attached a proposed workbook with a sample burn table (proposed-burn-plan.xlsx). Can we schedule a 30-min touch next week to lock the pacing and agree on the PO timeline?

Action items:
1) Sam: confirm SKU set + procurement contact
2) Marissa: prep co-sell checklist draft
3) Jonas: review ops constraints and flag any SKU reservations that won't map cleanly
4) Ben: confirm invoice timing we should expect with this cadence

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sam Park <sam.park@auroraanalytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 13:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Private offer & initial drawdown plan

Thanks Rishi + Sam —

Quick notes from the GTM/co-sell side:
- I'll own the marketplace listing coordination and the co-sell packet to GCP. For Aurora's pitch, we should include a 6–8 slide doc that calls out expected customer use cases and pilot timelines.
- Suggest small tweak to pacing: 30% / 40% / 10% / 5% / remainder across months 5–12. That gives Aurora a slightly higher runway for initial GTM while keeping later-month protection.
- We also need to confirm whether Aurora wants to be listed under our public listing with a private offer seat or have a separate private listing. That decision affects SKU mapping and co-sell attribution.
- I'll draft a "marketplace handoff checklist" and share a link by Wednesday.

Proposed meeting times next week: Tue 6/30 10:00 PT or Wed 7/1 9:00 PT. Sam, which works?

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 08:50:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Private offer & initial drawdown plan

Looping in ops notes —

- SKU mapping: please confirm exact GCP SKU ids. Some of the Aurora SKUs as described on the call map to two marketplace SKUs (runtime + infra). We'll need to reserve both to guarantee drawdown allocation.
- Invoice/invoice-splitting: with the proposed front-load, finance will see a lumpy redemption pattern. Recommend aligning invoice triggers with monthly reconciliation windows to avoid disputes.
- Onboarding checklist: I'll attach the ops doc (ops-onboarding-checklist.md) and mark required fields Aurora must complete (service account, billing project, IAM roles).

If we plan a 30%/40%/10% front load Marissa suggested, ops can support that but requests a 10-day buffer between signing and first redemption to wire SKU reservations.

-Jonas
Platform Ops

Thanks all —

We can accept Marissa's 30/40/10 front-load proposal. Procurement will prepare a PO after we agree the final SKUs. Our procurement contact is procurement@auroraanalytics.com. We will need DocuSign for signature and prefer monthly invoices aligned to the redemption cadence.

Attaching our PO template: po-template.pdf. Can Marissa share the co-sell slide draft and Rishi share the workbook with the final numbers once you settle?

—Sam
